## Supabase Manager v1.0.3

### Broker security update

- Update the broker to Next.js 16.4.6 and refresh its validation and tooling dependencies.
- Keep email validation responsive on long input.

Use `skuldgerry/supabase-manager:1.0.3-broker` (also `latest-broker`) for the broker. The Studio image for this release remains `skuldgerry/supabase-manager:1.0.2`.

Back up the Manager data volumes together before updating. See the [deployment guide](https://github.com/skuldgerry/supabase-manager/blob/v1.0.3/docs/deployment.md).
